base_member_text: depp is computed at L54 before dep is NaN-masked at L58, so panel 3 shows bed change everywhere including masked dry cells; the ordering differs from the eta masking and may be intentional or an oversight
audit_member_text: Masking is applied to eta, baseline dep, u, and v at L57-L60, but not to concentration `ch` or depth change `depp`, which was computed before masking at L52-L54. Thus the second and third panels can display dry-cell/sentinel values while the first panel and arrows hide them—an inconsistent mask interface.

base_member_text: dep masked in-place (L58) accumulates across frames when a multi-frame range is used
audit_member_text: Baseline `dep` is destructively masked inside the loop at L58; the current single-frame range hides accumulation, but any multi-frame range would retain earlier dry-mask NaNs and also compute later depp at L54 against an already-corrupted baseline.

base_member_text: concentration ch is plotted unmasked (no ch(mask<1)=NaN line, unlike the vessel scripts which mask ch); log10(ch) yields -Inf for zero concentration
concentration unit label g/l (L85) with caxis [-1 1] implies 0.1-10 g/l displayed; conversion assumptions are not stated in the file

audit_member_text: `log10(ch)` at L82 has no positive-value check; zero concentration yields -Inf and negative/sentinel values yield complex results, yet the finite caxis [-1,1] at L83 assumes valid logarithms.
Fixed ax=[0,249,0,199] is not derived from n,m,dx,dy, and no cross-array shape check precedes arithmetic/masking.
